author: Amy Palser
text: Chris is awesome! Twice now we have had a plumbing emergency and Chris has arrived quickly (which is everything in a plumbing emergency!), diagnosed and fixed the problem, and we were all relieved and happy as clams. He always has great customer service and a great price. Highly recommend!

author: Jody Pitterle
text: Chris was amazing and such a HUGE Blessing  to our family during our plumbing crises. There were multiple issues and he handled each one THOROUGHLY. He did not leave other issues for us to have to call him back on. He was fast on responding, scheduling and showed up the very next day.  I can't say enough positive things about this professional, friendly and hardworking guy!! Thanks again, Chris!!

author: Carmen Grajeda
text: Chris was great! Very responsive from the get go and was able to find and fix my leak quickly and efficiently. He was professional and explained the whole process. He relieved a lot of stress on my part and saved me a ton of money! Highly highly recommend!

author: Joel Potter
text:
Chris was quick to respond and even came very early in the morning to make it work!
He was very fast and knew exactly what he was doing. Everything worked perfectly when he was done installing our faucet lines. I highly recommend him!!!

author: Alvin Mason
text: I've used Chris on two occasions once to work with a contractor to remodel a bathroom in a very old building. It turned out immaculate. He returned another time and found the issue why my water bill was so high and fixed it. He has an excellent disposition and easy to work with.
